scope: OZERO Project Understanding and Tender Engineering Analysis

cases.expected: The consultant identifies the real project, purpose, and all established facilities from the prepared project model.
cases.observed: Turn 01a0ea74-1067-70a5-8d9b-bcb9c308d8e8 returned the storm-water project purpose and all 12 KNS/LOS facilities; deterministic and model quality checks passed.

cases.expected: A facility question returns its pit, structures, works, quantities, and materials rather than generic retrieval text.
cases.observed: Turn 01a0ea7b-106e-7510-a783-daab5667773d returned the KNS 4 pit, pressure pipeline and sheet-pile enclosure, 38 work types, role-labelled quantities including 95.028 t driving, 104.869 t extraction and 9.841 t bracing, and a material schedule. Both quality layers passed.

cases.expected: The application gives a professional pit inventory and does not convert unresolved groups into a false exact total.
cases.observed: The current model reports nine established pits, including four explicitly facility-bound and five quantified in groups, plus three unresolved designation groups. The final total remains explicitly undetermined.

cases.expected: Facility dossiers show same-scope design/commercial quantity comparisons with professional conclusions.
cases.observed: The deployed KNS 8.1 dossier contains five comparisons, including cable routing 30 m in PD versus 60 m in VOR and estimate, and matching sheet-pile driving/extraction values between VOR and estimate.

cases.expected: A facility comparison question returns exact prepared project and commercial values and differences, without requiring unrelated material findings.
cases.observed: Turn 01a0eac1-d4dc-7068-8360-ad8a90e1b75c succeeded through local Qwen and returned KNS 8.1 cable routing as PD 30 m versus VOR 60 m and estimate 60 m, with -30 m differences. Deterministic and model checks passed.

cases.expected: The current shared model exports as a readable editable Tender report and a complete analysis archive.
cases.observed: The application service generated a 56,103-byte DOCX and 1,029,998-byte ZIP from the live OZERO model. Strict DOCX validation passed all checks across 6,220 paragraphs; QuickLook visual inspection confirmed readable project and facility tables.

cases.expected: The consultant returns the prepared sheet-pile schedule, including associated belt/bracing scope and unresolved allocation.
cases.observed: Turn 01a0ea55-dcf1-7c2d-90b4-0fc59a3fe0e7 succeeded and returned 16 schedule rows with seven project/commercial issues.

cases.expected: Processed work descriptions become professional work scopes without hiding unresolved descriptions.
cases.observed: The current model classifies 3132 of 4377 construction-scope observations (71.6%), retains 1245 as unclassified, and separately excludes 2005 non-work observations.

cases.expected: A signed-in user visually navigates the deployed facility dossier, sources, and downloads through the public browser application.
cases.observed: The exact-SHA browser E2E passed in CI and the public frontend bundle is active, but no attachable signed-in browser session was available for this checkpoint.
